setup.seoDescription: Create the administrator account for your Biddu instance
setup.title: Initial setup
setup.subtitle: Your instance has no administrator yet. Create the account to get started.
setup.brandingDescription: This one-step wizard creates the administrator account for your instance. Afterwards you can configure email, invite users and create auctions.
setup.adminNoteMessage: This account is verified automatically and becomes the deployment admin. Nobody else will be able to use this wizard afterwards.
setup.emailDisabledHint: Email is not configured on this deployment: there is nothing to verify, this account signs straight in.
setup.alreadyCompleted: Setup was already completed. Sign in with your account.
